- The changes in `IndexFetcher.java` are directly linked to the bug fix, as they alter the replication behavior to prevent unnecessary full replications when the master is restarted, addressing the core issue identified in SOLR-9036.
- The new test case in `TestReplicationHandler.java` serves to validate the fix implemented in `IndexFetcher.java`. The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```java
core.getUpdateHandler().getSolrCoreState().setLastReplicateIndexSuccess(successfulInstall);
```
Reason:
The statement sets the replication success state without checking if the Solr instance is in SolrCloud mode. This means that in standalone mode, the success state is updated regardless of the actual replication success, leading to incorrect behavior where the slave thinks that a full replication is required after the master is restarted.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```java
if (core.getCoreDescriptor().getCoreContainer().isZooKeeperAware()) {
    core.getUpdateHandler().getSolrCoreState().setLastReplicateIndexSuccess(successfulInstall);
}
```
Reason:
This change ensures that the replication success state is only updated in SolrCloud mode, preventing unnecessary full replications when the master restarts and no actual changes have occurred in the index, thus fixing the bug.
